description: This file defines the ThreadInfo class, which models information about a thread within a process in an Android bug report context. It includes fields for process info, thread ID, and thread name, and a constructor to initialize these fields.

classes.name: ThreadInfo
classes.description: Class to represent what we can determine about a thread, including process it belongs to, thread identifier, and thread name.

methods.name: ThreadInfo
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a ThreadInfo object with a ProcessInfo, thread ID, and thread name.
